$comment: The Realistic world's climate (docs/proposals/REALISTIC_WORLD.md R3; owner 2026-11-11: "latitude + prevailing wind + terrain", the seed picks the latitude band). Read only where terrain.json `tectonics.climate` is 1 (worlds/realistic.json); the default and the other worlds keep biomeMap's wind and a uniform rain. bands: the latitude bands a face's seed draws from (by weight); a band spans the whole map north–south, from latitude[0] at the map's south edge to latitude[1] at its north edge (game scale: a real 100 km map spans under one degree), along a north axis the seed turns; northern hemisphere. seaLevel: the sea-level temperature (°C) by latitude (degrees), straight between the points, ascending; the temperature is that less lapseRate °C per 1000 m above the sea. winds: the prevailing wind cells by latitude (trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies), each blowing from `from` degrees of compass bearing (0 from the north, 90 from the east, clockwise; turned with the map's north); the band's wind is the cell at its middle latitude, turned by up to ± windJitter degrees by the seed. rain: the march along that wind over the seed's mountains (biomemap.rs `rainfall`, systemic terrain T1) on a coarse grid of `cell` m (coarser when the map would need more than maxCells a side, so a bigger map keeps the grid's size: BIG_MAP.md; no new whole-map 100 m grid, BUGS.md #70) over the uplifted ground before the erosion (§3.3's order), low-passed over smoothM m; baseRain per km on flat land, more by upliftRain per 10 % grade the ground rises along the wind, less by leeDry per 10 % grade it falls; the air dries over reachM m of full rain. maxGridBytes: the bound the coarse grid's memory must stay under (a test). discharge: the rain the rivers carry, the march's rain over its mean on land, kept within [min, max] (the windward rivers big, the lee's fed by the range). The biomes (R4): the march is run again on the eroded map for the biome field (§3.3's second pass) and its rain read in mm a year, Whittaker-style: a band's `rainMm` is the annual rain where the march rains its flat rate (flat land by the sea), more on windward slopes and less in the lee by the march's ratio to that rate, capped at biomes.maxRainMm; the presets' `where` ranges `celsius` and `rain` read the climate's °C and these mm. biomes.wetMm: the rain (mm) that counts as fully wet for the 0..1 wetness the vegetation's moisture reads, blended into the rivers' wetness by biomes.moistureShare (in place of biomeMap's rainShare). Prototype tuning.
